metadata.stratification_method: Block-stratified by tumor volume (wt_voxels) with separate proportional partitioning of BraTS-MEN-Train (762/191) and BraTS-MEN-Train-Fix (38/9).
metadata.disclaimer: INTERNAL VALIDATION ONLY: The 200-case validation partition represents an internal development holdout for model selection and checkpoint monitoring. It must never be termed an independent test set.
